run_relax_atoms_basic: run relax_atoms on an ASE Atoms object with default FIRE optimizer and 500 step limit
run_relax_atoms_with_fmax: run relax_atoms with a custom fmax convergence threshold for tighter force tolerance
run_relax_atoms_fix_symmetry: run relax_atoms with fix_symmetry enabled to constrain structural symmetry during relaxation
run_relax_atoms_with_cell_filter: run relax_atoms with a cell_filter_cls to allow cell optimization during relaxation
run_relax_atoms_with_observers: run relax_atoms with observer callbacks attached to the optimizer at specified intervals
